stages.name: simulation
stages.detail:
the board and its own onboard_led and onboard_button, 4 wire(s) in the diagram
           what it cannot show (3):
             onboard GPIOs: not checked: spark's store lacks the Wokwi definition that the board record names, its sha256 differs, or it does not parse
             ONBOARD_LED (GPIO21): the Wokwi stand-in has no LED on GPIO21, so spark wires Wokwi's LED to GPIO21 in its place: a passed run shows the level a scenario read on GPIO21, not a PWM duty or a brightness, nor that the board's own LED lights. Test it on the board.
             ONBOARD_BUTTON (GPIO47): the Wokwi stand-in has no button on GPIO47, so spark wires Wokwi's pushbutton to GPIO47 in its place: a scenario presses that part, not the board's own button. Test it on the board.
